figurative_meaning_bn: অন্য আসন নাই বা আসন বদল করে না এমন
figurative_meaning_en: Someone who has no other seat or refuses to change their seat/position
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এক আসনে বসে থেকে কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত বদলায় না।
প্রতিবেশী এক আসনের মানুষ, কখনো জায়গা ছাড়ে না।
example_sentences_in_english: He sits in one seat and never changes his decision.
The neighbor is a one-seat person, never leaves his spot.
note: The idiom reflects Bengali cultural emphasis on steadfastness, often used to describe unyielding attitudes in daily life.
